rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=24, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.001, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=2.5, img_sy=2.5, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-20 (FINAL). Base = iter-12 CHAMPION recipe at the iter-18 val_n=24 basis (proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=0.0005, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5, n_iter=300, val_n=24). ONE KNOB CHANGED: per-scan/warm-start Adam lr 5e-3 -> 1e-3 (isolated; seed reset to 42 to match the canonical val_n=24 iter-18 read 0.975450 so the lr delta is the only moving part). WHY lr IS THE LAST GENUINELY-UNTOUCHED LEVER: every iter 1-19 ran at the Wagner-BF default lr=5e-3 and NEVER touched it; all BF-sigma axes are exhausted (img_sr tight peak, img_n_bf=3 peak, img_kernel 7->9 flat, img_sx/img_sy 0.5..3.5 flat, proj_sr=0.0005 peak / 0.0001 flat, proj_n_bf=2 flat, proj_sx tighten DOWN, proj_sy flat) and n_iter/seed/val_n are documented. The ONE mechanistic lever the campaign-state notes record as ACTIVE on this substrate is per-scan lr-DOWN: the sibling U-Net N2I lifted breast 0.9553->0.9593 at lr 5e-3->1e-4 (anchor near the warm-start init). FAILURE MODE: hr=0, the 12-param bilateral pinned ~0.9755 ~1 dB under the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline (FBP-bounded noise floor on dense-view breast). HYPOTHESIS: dropping lr 5e-3->1e-3 lets each per-scan fit settle more precisely near the warm-start BF-sigma init instead of over-stepping in 300 Adam steps, possibly nudging SSIM above 0.975450 (if the BF was slightly over-stepping) or landing flat (if it was already converged) -- either way it characterizes the last untouched optimization knob and SEALS the FBP-bounded ceiling. The 12-param bilateral cannot overfit one scan (no pixel memory), so lr-DOWN here probes convergence precision, not regularization. WALL: step budget IDENTICAL to iter-18/19 (n_iter=300, val_n=24; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 24x300=7200); iter-18 ran 692 s, iter-19 ran 752 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged. ONE knob changed: lr 0.005->0.001 (isolated).
